Key: `name`

Path: [`type`](#typesfiletype).`[]`.`name`

Key: `category`

Path: [`type`](#typesfiletype).`[]`.`category`

### TypeDef.cost

Key: `cost`

Path: [`type`](#typesfiletype).`[]`.`cost`

| --- | --- |
| Type | `integer` |
| Required | no |

Key: `flags`

Path: [`type`](#typesfiletype).`[]`.`flags`

| --- | --- |
| Required | no |

### TypeDef.lifetime

Key: `lifetime`

Path: [`type`](#typesfiletype).`[]`.`lifetime`

Lifetime is how long, in seconds, an eligible spawned instance can remain before
economy cleanup removes it.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `integer` |
| Required | no |

### TypeDef.min

Key: `min`

Path: [`type`](#typesfiletype).`[]`.`min`

Min is the lower count threshold for this class. When the counted amount falls
below it, the economy prioritizes bringing the amount back up.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `integer` |
| Required | no |

### TypeDef.nominal

Key: `nominal`

Path: [`type`](#typesfiletype).`[]`.`nominal`

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `integer` |
| Required | no |

Key: `quantmax`

## TypeFlags

TypeFlags controls which locations contribute existing instances to the type's
economy count and marks special spawn handling.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `object` |
| Properties | 6 |
| Additional properties | boolean schema=false |

### TypeFlags.count_in_cargo

Key: `count_in_cargo`

Path: [`type`](#typesfiletype).`[]`.[`flags`](#typedeftypeflags).`count_in_cargo`

CountInCargo includes instances stored inside another item's cargo when the CE
compares the current count with Nominal and Min.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `integer` |
| Required | no |

Path: [`type`](#typesfiletype).`[]`.[`flags`](#typedeftypeflags).`count_in_hoarder`

| --- | --- |
| Type | `integer` |
| Required | no |

Key: `count_in_map`

Path: [`type`](#typesfiletype).`[]`.[`flags`](#typedeftypeflags).`count_in_map`

| --- | --- |
| Type | `integer` |
| Required | no |
